newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Stock Exchange names Henige as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Stock Exchange names Henige as CFO.

text.p: The Chicago Stock Exchange (CHX), said James Monteville (Monte) Henige will become its chief financial officer, effective January 13, 1997.

He joins the stock exchange, the second largest in the United States, from Deloitte & Touche LLP, where he worked with clients including securities broker/dealers, futures commission merchants, clearing firms, mutual fund managers and international stock and commodity funds, CHX said.

"His in-depth knowledge of the CHX and the high quality of his work in the financial services industry make him a welcome addition to our management team," Robert Forney, CHX president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
